title: Detail overlay
description: An item of a list opens over the list instead of on its own page: its own URL (?open=<id> with useDetailParam, Next App Router safe), ‹ › and ← → through the current results with “n / N”, close / Esc / Back return to the list at the same scroll position. The side panel holds the actions (SplitButton, an icon row, ⋯); existing detail routes stay as deep-link targets.
when: Open a record from a list, grid or table and step through the results without losing the list (suppliers, orders, leads).
A shared link to a record that should land over its list.

instead.need: Edit a few fields of a row
A long workflow with its own sub-pages
A mail or chat reader beside the list

a11y: A modal dialog named by its title (an h2), focus trapped and returned to the row that opened it; Escape closes.
‹ › are labelled (Mục trước / Mục sau, with aria-keyshortcuts) and disabled at the ends; “n / N” is read as “Mục n trên N”; ← → do not fire inside inputs, menus or sliders.

examples.title: List with ?item= in the URL
examples.description: Open a row, step with ← →, press Back: the list is where you left it.
